verdicts.reason: A is basically the banner stretched out: the product can is tiny and stuck to the left edge, the cream circle has come loose and drifted to the bottom-left corner, the headline, badge and subcopy are spread far apart with big dead gaps, and the subcopy sits way below its headline. B uses a sensible two-column layout with a large product, but the cream circle backdrop has also come loose into the bottom-left corner, the can melts into the background because its fill matches the orange, the CTA isn't lined up with the text column, and the NEW badge is stranded in the top-right corner.
